mirrorOrOtherProjectWarning: No mirror and no other project. The renders come in TWO FINISH VARIANTS of the same house: grey vertical fibre-cement/metal panels with white render (images 5, 8, 15 and all elevation drawings) and vertical timber slats with white render (images 6, 11). Geometry and openings are identical. Note the entrance is on a LONG side, so FRONT is the 15.24 m side and both gable ends (LEFT, RIGHT) are blank.

mainRoof.notes: Simple symmetrical gable roof over the whole block, ridge along the long axis; no eaves or verge overhang (flush, hidden gutters), no dormers, no rooflights. Blank triangular gables at both short ends.
